system.description: As a Swift Action, you can designate a single target within line of sight and make a Knowledge (Galactic Lore) check against a DC equal to 15 + the target's CL. If the check is successful, for the remainder of the encounter you gain a +2 morale bonus to the Defense Score of your choice against that target.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Force Unleashed Campaign Guide
